limitations: Synthetic fixtures and in-memory localStorage only.
No real DeepSeek, production API, production scheduler or medical accuracy validation.
Model API permission demonstrations are not server-side access control.
No actual four-hour capacity or browser visual verification.

results.title: Known fixture totals and independent response denominators
results.oracle: Eight independently identified conversations contain 25 body messages: 22 effective and 3 excluded. Three timeout events belong to two of six applicable conversations.

results.title: Cross-midnight grouping, prior-day ownership and observation context
results.oracle: 23:55→00:03 is 8 minutes; 23:55→00:16 is 21; 23:59/00:02→00:10 is 8 from the last customer message. The 28-minute prior-day event contributes neither numerator nor denominator today.

results.title: One filter updates all seven module inputs without changing the source report
results.oracle: Work account 01 owns exactly four conversations, five body messages and one issue. Filtering cannot leave other-account rows or mutate the unfiltered report.

results.title: One failed channel remains independent and unresolved media prevents completion
results.oracle: Personal WeChat has 7 successful and 1 failed tasks plus one unparsed voice and image. Retrying the same input can recover the failed task but cannot invent media content or advance the revision.

results.title: Scoped evidence and default-off tenants
results.oracle: Every issue cites a real message in its own conversation. The limited-evidence fixture, another channel, non-demo tenants and an unknown channel must refuse evidence or mutations.

results.title: Independent prompt drafts, exact trial binding and explicit publication
results.oracle: Saving a prompt cannot enable it. An edited draft cannot reuse an earlier passing trial, a failing trial cannot publish, and the other channel configuration remains unchanged.

results.title: Common-rule publication requires each enabled channel and preserves effective rules on failure
results.oracle: When both channels are enabled, a changed common draft invalidates old trials. One passing channel or a failed second trial cannot publish; both passing channels cause a single r2 publication.

results.title: Frozen history, rerun revisions, request idempotency and failed latest revision
results.oracle: Changing a threshold to 60 minutes and removing configured products affects a new revision only. Request retries reuse it; a later failed revision remains the latest and does not hide behind old success.

results.title: Review and handling are separate; corrections retain original AI judgement
results.oracle: Marking handled does not confirm an issue. Confirm then false-positive removes the confirmed count but keeps the AI candidate and three audit entries. Intent correction preserves AI intent.

results.title: Fourteen synthetic dimensions preserve applicability, uncertainty and valid evidence
results.oracle: Every conversation has fourteen explicit dimension decisions. Short conversations do not inherit required business actions; unknown media does not become a passing semantic finding; candidate findings retain their original AI state after human correction.

results.title: Storage failures, corruption and reload
results.oracle: A rejected browser write must not mutate stored configuration or emit success. A new model instance reads saved state; malformed scoped data is an error rather than default success.

results.title: Late start is not represented as on-time completion
results.oracle: The fixed 2026-10-22 report starts at 05:00 and finishes at 08:30: elapsed time is 3.5 hours, while the 08:00 target is missed. This checks presentation data, not actual throughput.

results.title: Initial prompt prose matches the canonical approved draft bodies
results.oracle: The embedded bodies match the two SPEC prompt documents after the template-body heading; configuration notes are not silently mixed into model prose.

results.title: Model choices come from one saved directory and respect enabled scene support
results.oracle: Platform and enterprise examples are selectable; disabled and old-scene examples are not. Existing deepseek-existing bindings remain valid without migrating channel storage.

results.title: Empty prompt binding resolves the scene default and binds trial to the final configuration
results.oracle: The final default model changes only after a simulated platform directory update; this invalidates the prior trial and records the actually resolved configuration in the new report snapshot.

results.title: Disabled, unsupported and missing-default configurations fail closed
results.oracle: A binding is retained with an explicit failure instead of silently selecting an available alternative. New trials and new batches fail; reading historical data still works.

results.title: Final model parameter changes invalidate both prompt and common-rule validation
results.oracle: Changing the selected configuration after trial makes that trial stale. Common-rule publication must also revalidate the effective model parameters of enabled channels.

results.title: Enterprise model page preserves captured rows and exposes no model mutation controls
results.oracle: Tenant-isolated synthetic snapshots and four clearly marked quality fixtures share one read-only table. Missing tenants never reuse another catalog.
